description: Source code defining the Kustomization type and related functions for handling Kubernetes customization configurations in the kustomize tool.

classes.name: Kustomization
classes.description: Struct representing a Kubernetes kustomization configuration, including metadata, resources, patches, generators, and related options.

methods.name: CheckDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Checks for usage of deprecated fields in the Kustomization struct and returns warning messages.

methods.name: FixKustomization
methods.description: Fixes deprecated or empty fields in the Kustomization struct, migrating data to current fields.

methods.name: FixKustomizationPreMarshalling
methods.description: Prepares the Kustomization struct for marshalling by resolving patch references and label conflicts.

methods.name: CheckEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Kustomization struct is empty.

methods.name: EnforceFields
methods.description: Enforces correct values for kind and apiVersion fields, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Unmarshals YAML data into the Kustomization struct, with validation.
